BiblicalUsage: The word is the ark, a chest made to float. God told Noah to make an ark of gopher wood and pitch it within and without, and to come into the ark with all his house; and God remembered Noah and every living thing that was with him in the ark. Moses' mother made an ark of bulrushes and daubed it with slime and pitch, and laid the child in the flags by the river's brink.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the ark is God's way of saving through water: Noah's family rode it out, and Moses floated in one. My position is that the same God who shut Noah in also set Moses afloat, and both arks carried the future.
